strings.قبل ما تدخل أول دفعة مواد، وقف عند سؤال: Before the first material delivery, decide where it will be stored and how it will enter. Site preparation affects workflow and protection of existing items. Lesson five of the Almusaileem series develops a simple homeowner’s plan, whether the property is empty or still occupied by the family during renovation.

strings.خذ معك نطاق الأعمال، مخططًا مبسطًا، وصور: Take with you the scope of the business, a simplified layout, and up-to-date pictures of the rooms. You are required to look at an inventory list, an entry and storage map, and the distribution of protection and cleaning responsibilities. Discuss them with the site administrator before moving furniture or supplying materials. This step may overlap with second stages; the specialist determines the appropriate arrangement according to the condition of the house and the type of business.
strings.ميّز بين ما يبقى وما يُنقل وما يُزال: Distinguish between items to retain, relocate and remove
strings.مر على كل غرفة وسجل الأرضيات والأبواب وا: Pass through each room and record the floors, doors, cabinets, and lighting you want to keep in. Picture its current state from clear angles, and record any scratch or damage that is present. Select what items will be moved outside the work area, and who will take them and return them. Personal items and important pieces kept in a separate place before delivery.
Do not limit yourself to the word “full protection” in the discussion. Ask about the elements covered, how to protect the corners and edges, and who reviews the cover and replaces it when needed. strings.ارسم طريق المواد ومكان التخزين: Draw the material route and storage location
strings.وضح المدخل المستخدم، والممر المؤدي لمنطق: Explain the entrance used, the corridor leading to the work area, and the place designated for receiving and examining materials. If access is through common facilities, arrange arrangements with the responsible person before delivery. Also agree on the way to deal with damaged packaging or non-conforming materials, even if mixed with acceptable materials and entered into execution by mistake.
strings.إرشادات HSE لتنظيم المواد والمخلفات: HSE Guidelines for the Regulation of Materials and Wastes
strings.على إبقاء مسارات الوصول والخروج خالية من: To keep the access and exit routes free of storage and determine the responsibility of site arrangement. We use them here as principles of organization and general safety, not Kuwaiti requirements. The place of storage and the method of stacking materials and protect them from the surrounding conditions are reviewed by the contractor according to the instructions of the project products.
strings.إذا الأسرة ساكنة، خطط للاستخدام اليومي: If the family is still, plan for daily use
strings.حدد مع مسؤول الموقع المساحات التي يمكن ا: Identify with the site administrator the spaces that can be used, and areas that should be separated from the accommodation. Discuss the movement of children, household animals, access to the bathroom and kitchen, and any special need of a family member. Do not assume that simply closing a door makes the adjacent room suitable for use; assess dust, ventilation and risk liability of specialists.
strings.اسأل شنو الأعمال التي قد تحتاج إخلاء منط: Ask what works you may need to clear an area or change the order of use, and who will tell you before they start. The instructions for disconnecting and returning electricity or water are from the responsible specialist, and do not take them on your own.
strings.صبغ البيت وأنت ساكن فيه: Paint the house and you live in it.

strings.اكتب اسم جهة الاتصال لكل مرحلة، ومن يتاب: Write the contact name for each stage, and who follows the waste, cleaning, and protection check. Before moving a new team, review the status of the place, work done, and note log. If a problem arises, document its location and notify the administrator instead of issuing conflicting instructions to more than one worker. Agree on how to update the plan if the scope of work changes or an additional treatment room is needed.
